changes.name: SeamlessIslandBlendV42
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local starter=world:WaitForChild("StarterIsland")

-- Make all connected expansion land visually match the starter island
-- so seams between upgrades disappear as much as possible.
local function blendPart(p)
 if not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
 if p.Name:match("^L%d+_") or p.Name:find("Expansion") then
  p.Material=starter.Material
  p.Color=starter.Color
  p.Reflectance=starter.Reflectance
  p.Transparency=starter.Transparency
  -- Match the top surface height exactly.
  local starterTop=starter.Position.Y+(starter.Size.Y/2)
  p.Position=Vector3.new(p.Position.X,starterTop-(p.Size.Y/2),p.Position.Z)
 end
end

local function blendAll()
 local directional=world:FindFirstChild("DirectionalExpansions")
 if directional then
  for _,v in ipairs(directional:GetDescendants()) do blendPart(v) end
 end
 for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do blendPart(v) end
end

blendAll()
world.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
 task.wait()
 blendPart(v)
end)

-- Re-apply after expansion rise animations finish.
while task.wait(1) do
 blendAll()
end
